Name: JP's Utility Commands
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Utility Commands[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]
[color=#9900ff][size=5][b][i]Because it's faster if you write fast...[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]This mod adds more than 30 new commands that you can use at any time to speed up your games or just to have fun for a while, almost all of them are harmless and not destructive. 
[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i][u]A list of the commands and what they do:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[size=4]Help:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]HelpUtCom[/color]: helputcom Shows detailed help for all Utility Commands. In addition to the correct use and other tips. [/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Time & Speed Controls:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeTime[/color]: givemetime <seconds/off> Controls game time speed. Seconds parameter accepts values from 0.1 to 60, or 'off' to disable.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeSpeed[/color]: givemespeed [level] Changes player movement speed. Level ranges from -100 to 100, or use 'min'/'max'.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Animal Management:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMePetHere[/color]: givemepethere [PetName] Teleports specified pet to player's location.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAnimalHere[/color]: givemeanimalhere [AnimalName] Teleports specified farm animal to player's location.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAHorse[/color]: givemeahorse Spawns a new horse below the player. [color=#00ffff]You can use it even without Stable, but it will disappear when you dismount. [/color][/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMePetLove[/color]: givemepetlove [PetName] [points] Sets pet friendship points (0-1000).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAnimalLove[/color]: givemeanimallove [AnimalName] [points] Sets farm animal friendship points (0-1000).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeMorePet[/color]: givememorepet [PetName] Allows multiple pet interactions per day with specified pet.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAgeAnimal[/color]: givemeageanimal [AnimalName] [baby / adult] Changes specified animal's age state between baby and adult.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Visual Effects:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMePekka[/color]: givemepekka [Count] Creates magical butterfly display around player. Count ranges from 1 to 9999 butterflies.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeFireFly[/color]: givemefirefly [Count] Creates firefly display around player. Count ranges from 1 to 9999 fireflies.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Building & House:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeBetterHouse[/color]: givemebetterhouse [level] Upgrades house to specified level (0-3). [color=#00ffff]Using the command does not rearrange the objects inside the house so they could be left outside the boundaries, floating in the vast emptiness. [/color][/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeBetterBuilding[/color]: givemebetterbuilding [BuildingName] [level] [index/x y] Upgrades farm building. Specify building type, level (0-2), and either index or coordinates. Only for buildings on the map where you are currently located.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Tools & Items:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeBetterTool[/color]: givemebettertool [ToolName] [level] Upgrades specified tool to desired level (0-4).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeSpecialItem[/color]: givemespecialitem Gives special wallet items (skullkey, clubcard, specialcharm, etc).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeTheBook[/color]: givemethebook Gives player the Animal Catalogue.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeSkillBooks[/color]: givemeskillbooks Gives you all the Skill books. [/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeBooks[/color]: givemebooks Gives you all available books, including mods. Only once per book.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeTheLostBooks[/color]: givemethelostbooks Gives you all the missing books.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeASurprise[/color]: givemeasurprise Gives random ???.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Community Center & Access:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAllCC[/color]: givemeallcc Completes all Community Center bundles.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAcc[/color]: givemeacc Unlocks Community Center features.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAccess[/color]: givemeaccess Unlocks NPC doors and Guild access.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Relationship Management:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeTheLove[/color]: givemethelove [NPCName] [type] Progresses NPC relationship. Type can be 'date' or 'spouse'. [color=#00ffff]Using the spouse command with several npc causes them all to stay in one corner of the house. Maybe with some polygamy mod this will be solved. [/color][/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeFriends[/color]: givemefriends [NPCName/All] [points] Changes NPC friendship points (0-3500).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeNoLove[/color]: givemenolove [NPCName/All] Removes NPC relationship status.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeNPCHere[/color]: givemenpchere [NPCName] transports the selected NPC to your location. [color=#00ffff]This command is destructive since the npc will not find his way to his daily routine, but it is fun.[/color][/size]
[/list][size=4]
Skills & Buffs:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeLevel[/color]: givemelevel [skill] [level] Sets skill experience to reach specified level (1-10).[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeBuff[/color]: givemebuff [buff] [level] Applies specified buff until sleep. Multiple buffs can be set.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Location Access:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeTheMines[/color]: givemethemines Teleports player to mines level 120, and unlocks the elevator.[/size]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]GiveMeAStore[/color]: givemeastore [shopID] Open the menu of the selected store from anywhere.[/size]
[/list][/font]
[color=#ff00ff][size=6][i][u]Translations:[/u][/i][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#f4f4f4][/color]If you want, you can make the translation of this mod, [color=#ff0000]no need to ask for permission[/color], and you can publish it on your own in Nexus. [color=#ffff00]This is best because I won't be available to update the translations if you send it to me.[/color] [color=#f4f4f4][/color][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]I will not do the usual translations into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese either, so you are more than welcome to do translations into these languages. [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you like you can let me know when you have published your translations so that I know you are there.[/size][size=3] [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5]Thank you![/size][/color][/font]
[/list][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Do not translate words between {{these}}.
[/size][/color][/b]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and move the folder directly to the Mods folder. If you like the mod, click the “Endorse” button at the top of the page ;)
